title: Enjoy our Tonic Cottage | Rosemary Beach Vacation Home | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This lovely Rosemary Beach vacation home is designed for you to experience relaxation and fun on your vacation! Enjoy a collection of original art and luxury! Click here to book!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Close to Cabana Pool

Tonic, as the word applies, goes with everything.

This cottage was truly designed and furnished for relaxation and fun. It has a nice collection of original art, architectural fragments and antique pond boats throughout the home.

Start with thirteen foot ceilings in both the chefs kitchen and dining area. A century old seven-foot round dining table seats twelve and is illuminated by a large antique iron chandelier. Travel two steps up to the foyer and find where Tonic gets it's name, You can't miss it! Beyond is the indoor living room with a Rumford fireplace. Flanking the fireplace are French doors leading to the outdoor living room; also with a fireplace. There is a gas grill and old soap stone sink adjacent to this A fountian rounds out this lovely outdoor area.

This cottage has four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms. The first floor has a queen bed, and a private bath. Entering through a set of 150 year old Brownstone doors gives it a suite feel. All three bedrooms on the second floor have their own private balconies. The master suite has a king bed, a small den-like seating area and a private bath. There is a bedroom with a queen bed and private bath as well as a bedroom with two double beds and a private bath. Tonic sits on the corner of Georgetown and Water Street on one of the largest lots in Rosemary Beach and has views of nearby St. Augustine Park.

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY
